title: Cloudflare is seeing an issue with Workers API availability

timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating an issue impacting the Cloudflare Workers API, customers may be seeing an increase in 5xx errors deploying Workers or doing other API actions.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
